name: Limrun
description:
Limrun gives your agent iOS simulators and Android emulators in the cloud. Ask for a device and it is ready in seconds, with your app pre-installed if you want. From there the agent works the way a tester would: it takes screenshots, reads the accessibility tree, taps, types, scrolls, opens URLs, launches apps and pulls logs. Delete the device when you are done, or let it shut down on its own.

Building apps and anything that touches local files stays with the lim CLI. The server tells the agent where that line is and hands it the step-by-step CLI instructions when needed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Limrun to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Limrun to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.limrun.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Limrun MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Limrun lists 15 MCP tools, including android-open-url, android-screenshot-and-element-tree, android-use, create-android-emulator, create-ios-simulator, delete-instance, get-agent-skill, get-instance-status, ios-app, ios-logs, ios-open-url, and ios-screenshot-and-element-tree.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Limrun?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Limrun in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Limrun requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Limrun is developed by Limrun. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
